name: miaiplugin
description: AI-assistent til Word, Excel og PowerPoint mod lokale OpenAI-kompatible modeller

scripts.build: npm run build -w @miai/shared && npm run build -w @miai/bridge && npm run build -w @miai/addin
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @miai/shared && npm run dev -w @miai/addin
scripts.dev:bridge: npm run build -w @miai/shared && concurrently -n addin,bridge "npm run watch -w @miai/addin" "npm run dev -w @miai/bridge"
